binding_rules.render: direct path, storage SHA-256/bytes, and provider-visible SHA-256/bytes
binding_rules.attempt: exact 25-key create-only fuse path and storage SHA-256/bytes
binding_rules.receipt: unchanged exact 55-key receipt-v4 path and storage SHA-256/bytes
binding_rules.capture: unchanged exact 20-key capture-v3 path and storage SHA-256/bytes
binding_rules.score: unchanged scorer output path, storage SHA-256/bytes, and PASS/FAIL verdict
binding_rules.rollout: exact path and storage SHA-256/bytes plus receipt thread_id/turn_id/nonce wrapper proof

seal_rule: Completion-v3 is proposed only after render, attempt, receipt, capture, and score independently reopen and recompute. External apply_patch creates it last. Schedule advancement is forbidden until r8_run_verifier.py independently reopens the completed chain.
semantic_fail_rule: A deterministic semantic FAIL remains a sealed permanent first-attempt result, stops qualification, and is never retried or replaced.
recovery_rule: A valid exact receipt after an attempt can resume capture, score, and completion with zero subject calls. Process-loss recovery of an attempt without a receipt is permanent invalid and never relaunchable.
nonclaims: No completion-v3 was empirically produced by this candidate build.
No subject/provider/network call, audit, freeze, or qualification occurred.
